decisions: No dimension reduction exists here: dimension!=2, real/synthetic=false, nonzero z or nonzero direction-z is rejected.
Keep full xyz in artificial source specifications, render only the explicitly zero-z 2D components.
Time refinement changes only the injection-window maximum step and initial step; all circuit timing remains inherited.
Request all accepted-time current samples; do not thin device currents independently of mixed-mode circuit samples.
A3 x=0 half-domain charge is computed before running; total prescribed charge is still 1fC and domain charge is 0.5fC.
A0 absence of radiation datasets can prove only a source-free structure; never claim a measured numerical zero field from absence.
Chosen HeavyIon c2=1,c3=0,c4=1 is explicit and differs from the installed default; no default-equivalence claim.
Each A8 subsegment owns a disjoint longitudinal interval and its proportional charge once; A8 compares against this revision's A1 with matching A0.
Source parameters are interface fixtures, not calibrated particle radial or timing physics.
The old r2 time oracle misread sqrt(2)*s as 2*s; revision3 corrects the analytic observer only. Actual deck s_hi remains2ps.
No r2 A1 failure is promoted; failed measurement paths remain diagnostic raw data.
Only preplanned mesh factor 0.5 changes spatial discretization relative to base; source/par/circuit/time remain frozen.
A0/A1 mesh references are newly generated by the unchanged r2 builder; they are physical input references, never claimed passed runs.
All new r4 observation changes are isolated from their byte-identical r2 mesh physical matching contracts.
No root scheduler, SSH, solver, installation, training or remote message is implemented here.

evidence.purpose: Native named window integrals, Coordinates centroid, um integration units and HeavyIon kernel; licensed copy remains outside source directory
Optional native TDR field inventory and window integration; not fabricated pixel measurement
Range with no Intervals outputs all computed times; adding Intervals forces requested time points; NoOverwrite numbers output files
Frozen prior investigation and known Window failure; original runner complete-project archive limitation

global_budget.scheduler: root only; every actual candidate attempt counts against one global 19; builder does not execute or reserve solver attempts

kernel.domain_clipping: Account before solving; never renormalize after clipping or observing TCAD
kernel.segment_endpoints: half-open analytic segments; TCAD endpoint discretization is measured by A8, not assumed identical

measurement.acceptance_path: Independent legacy CurrentPlot total plus native SVisual measured complete accepted-step gstep TDR sequence; Window CurrentPlot is diagnostic only
measurement.centroid: Native per-frame measured generation-weighted spatial centroid, not source coordinates copied as data
measurement.charge_integral: sum_i measured G_i*(t_i-t_(i-1)); exact PLT interval mapping plus successful native Writing/BE step evidence
measurement.dynamic_output_semantics: All actual accepted simulation times in Range; no Intervals, MinSpacing, or forced extra times; actual filename and time association require native log/PLT evidence
measurement.generation_time_semantics: BE accepted-step average is tested from full native frames; five prior matching frames do not prove whole sequence
measurement.historical_failure: r2/r3 source-interface failures retained; r3 legacy/noWindow ~1.00416388fC while HI Window=0 despite valid Temperature windows; no promotion to source pass
measurement.missing_frame_policy: Fail/incomplete; no interpolation, analytic replacement, fitted waveform, or five-frame reconstruction
measurement.native_extractor: Separate audited native SVisual implementation; never execute from builder
measurement.project_output_inventory: Only fixed expected filenames; no wildcard. Original runner tar archives whole project; audit verifies every dynamic TDR independently.
measurement.temporal_centroid: Measured interval weights at interval midpoints
measurement.time_window_scope: TDR directly observes injection window only; legacy curve independently measures total 0-4ns. Do not replace unmeasured outside-window tails with the analytic oracle.
measurement.zero_source_centroid: A0 omits Coordinates on zero generation integrals; missing field remains structural_zero_not_measured_zero

scope: Only artificial A0/A1 bit1 mesh=0.5 spatial-resolution and measurement diagnostics; inherited uncalibrated 2D cell; no 3D projection/training/SEE claim
tolerance_basis: Pre-registered engineering gates authorized by root. Refinement and segmentation use the user-approved 2% generated charge and max(1mV,5% perturbation peak) control-relative voltage gates. Port current integrals are diagnostic only. These gates do not establish device calibration.
